title: Double Japanese Sesame-Crumbed Tofu
subtitle: with Sushi Rice, Teriyaki Mayo & Salad
description: Who said meat-free dishes can't be satisfying and salivating? Enjoy crisp, golden tofu drizzled with umami mayo, and teamed with home-made sushi rice plus a vibrant salad for an unforgettable feast!

steps.text:
•

• In a medium saucepan, bring the water (for the rice) to the boil.
• Add jasmine rice, stir, cover with a lid and reduce heat to low.
• Cook for 10 mins, then remove the pan from heat and keep covered until rice is tender and water absorbed, 10 mins.

•

• Meanwhile, grate carrot.
• Thinly slice tomato into wedges.
• In a shallow bowl, combine the plain flour and a pinch of salt and pepper. In a second shallow bowl, whisk the egg. In a third shallow bowl, combine sesame seeds and panko breadcrumbs (see ingredients).
• Dip Japanese tofu steaks into flour mixture to coat, then into egg and finally in breadcrumb mixture. Set aside on a plate.
• In a small bowl, combine teriyaki seasoning, the soy sauce, honey and water (for the sauce).

•

• Heat a large frying pan over medium-high heat with enough olive oil to coat the base.
• Cook crumbed tofu in batches until golden and cooked through, 2-4 mins each side. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate.
• Wipe out frying pan and return to medium heat.
• Add teriyaki mixture, stirring, until heated and bubbling, 1-2 mins. Transfer to a bowl.

•

• In a medium bowl, combine salad leaves, carrot, tomato and Japanese-style dressing. Season to taste.
• Stir the mayonnaise into the teriyaki mixture until combined.
• Once rice is done, stir in the vinegar and a pinch of white sugar until well combined.
• Cut tofu into strips (if desired).
• Divide sushi rice and salad between bowls. Top with sesame-crumbed Japanese tofu. Drizzle with teriyaki mayo.
